subject: Request: Product-specialist SE headcount + comp-band exception
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Product-specialist SE headcount + comp-band exception

Team —

Following the Strategic-Edge discovery last week, the account requires a product-focused SE (Senior level) with deep embeddings/LLM deployment experience to close the deal in Q3. This is a time-sensitive win: they want a technical partner embedded during POC and have signaled they will consolidate with the vendor that can staff a dedicated SE and run two-week production load tests.

Why this is an exception:
- The role is more senior than our usual SE hire for this team (we need >5 years with on-prem and VPC experience).
- Market comps in SF are pushing total comp ~15–20% above our standard mid-SE band for similar responsibilities.
- The candidate profile is narrow; we expect a 6–8 week sourcing window.

Request:
1) Approval to open 1 headcount (Senior Product Specialist, SE) on the Solutions team (new FTE).
2) One-time comp-band exception: increase offer ceiling to the upper bound of our Senior SE band + $10k hiring premium to secure the candidate.
3) Fast-track offer approval workflow with People Ops (Aditya) to allow a final offer within 48 hours of selection.

Attached: JD_SE_Product_Specialist.pdf (role + must-haves) and a preliminary cost sheet.

Proposed timeline: open req today -> shortlist in 3 weeks -> offer by mid-May if possible.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want more detail.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

[attachment: JD_SE_Product_Specialist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Product-specialist SE headcount + comp-band exception

Ben —

Thanks for the context and the JD. This sounds like a high-impact ask and I agree we should move quickly for Strategic-Edge if the pipeline is real. A few follow-ups before I sign off:

1) Can you share the estimated on-target-cost (OTC) including benefits and the proposed base / equity mix? I want line-of-sight on FY26 quota cost.
2) Is this replacing an open role or an incremental headcount? If incremental, confirm which hiring pool this should draw from.
3) Confirm manager-of-record for performance reviews (I assume you).

If the OTC delta is within ~20% of our standard senior band, I'm comfortable with a one-time hiring premium approval, but I want People Ops (Aditya) to confirm the exact band ceiling and sign the approval sheet. Laura — can you confirm if we have an available HC bucket in Q2 for this?

If everyone agrees, I'll escalate to Karthik for final budget sign-off today.

Best,
Evelyn

Evelyn —

Quick answers inline:
1) OTC estimate (attached cost_breakdown_SE_specialist.xlsx): total first-year cost ~ $235k fully burdened if we go to the requested ceiling + $10k premium. Breakdown: base $150k–165k (depending on exact comp), equity $25k~30k value, benefits & burden ~$40k.
2) This is incremental headcount tied to the Strategic-Edge opportunity; not a replacement.
3) I will be the manager-of-record.

Hiring rationale (short): Strategic-Edge controls >$12M in ARR potential for us in 18 months; they require a dedicated SE and technical delivery playbook during POC. If we do not staff appropriately we risk losing the deal to a competitor already offering dedicated resources.

I've also started a parallel conversation with Ellis Recruitment (external) to identify 2–3 shortlist candidates quickly; candidate pipeline looks promising (one passive candidate has expressed interest).

Ben

Ben / Evelyn —

Thanks for the succinct request and the OTC. Given the potential upside (deal_98765 linked to Strategic-Edge) and the time-sensitive nature, I approve the incremental headcount and a one-time hiring premium up to $10k on top of the Senior SE band ceiling. Conditions:

- Aditya (People Ops) must confirm the exact band ceiling and sign the offer approval sheet before any verbal offer is extended.
- The final offer must include a 30/70 base:variable alignment consistent with quota responsibilities.
- We run this as a canary hire — if the candidate is onboarded and we see delivery impact in 90 days, we'll open the second headcount.

Please proceed and keep me in the loop. Ben, have recruitment prioritize this role and keep the timeline tight.

Karthik
VP, Go-to-Market Operations
